indication.text: TissueBlue (Brilliant Blue G Ophthalmic Solution) 0.025% is a disclosing agent indicated to selectively stain the internal limiting membrane (ILM).

citations.quote: TissueBlue (Brilliant Blue G Ophthalmic Solution) 0.025% is a disclosing agent indicated to selectively stain the internal limiting membrane (ILM). (1)

target_moa.text: Brilliant Blue G forms a stable negatively charged complex with basic amino acid residues of proteins (mainly arginine and aromatic amino acids), selectively staining the ILM but not the epiretinal membrane or retina, making the transparent membrane easier to visualize for removal.

citations.quote: The dye forms a stable negatively charged complex with basic amino acid residues of proteins, mainly arginine and aromatic amino acids. The stained membrane is easier to visualize for removal.

Brilliant Blue G has been shown to selectively stain the ILM, but not the epiretinal membrane nor the retina, making it easier to visualize the membrane for removal, although the exact mechanism of this selectivity has not been elucidated.

Brilliant Blue G is a common laboratory reagent used for protein visualization during gel electrophoresis or quantitation (Bradford assay). The dye forms a stable negatively charged complex with basic amino acid residues of proteins, mainly arginine and aromatic amino acids. The stained membrane is easier to visualize for removal.

key_safety.text: Adverse reactions reported in procedures using TissueBlue have often been associated with the surgical procedure and include retinal complications (retinal break, tear, hemorrhage, and detachment) and cataracts.

citations.quote: Adverse reactions that have been reported in procedures that included the use of Brilliant Blue G Ophthalmic Solution have often been associated with the surgical procedure. These complications include retinal (retinal break, tear, hemorrhage, and detachment) and cataracts.
